sources.title: National Portal of India · Silver Filigree (Tarakashi Art)
sources.note: Describes fine silver wire made into jewellery and decorative objects in Cuttack. This description does not certify the metal in a particular object or identify a workshop available to visit.

sources.title: Dsource · Silver Filigree, Cuttack — Making Process
sources.note: Prof. Bibhudutta Baral and Hariharasudan T., NID Bengaluru. Documents sketching, wire drawing, thicker frames, fine-wire infill, soldering, filing and polishing. The diagram and observation prompts here are our own explanations, not instructions for reproducing a maker’s design.

sources.title: ଆଶୁତୋଷ କର · Chaudhury Bazar Chandi Medha
sources.note: The photographer identifies this Cuttack Durga Puja setting as a Chandi Medha with silver filigree work and dates the photograph to 26 September 2009. It documents that display, not current festival arrangements or the purity of its materials. CC BY-SA 3.0.
